items.text: Tutorial is awful. Everything is so cluttered and all over the place. I couldn't recommend this game unless you enjoy game breaking bugs with wasted time invested. Maybe the 1.0 will address this, but right now I couldn't recommend it.
items.text_zh: 教程很糟糕。一切都那么杂乱，到处都是。除非你喜欢破坏游戏的bug和白白投入的时间，否则我无法推荐这款游戏。也许1.0版本会解决这个问题，但现在我无法推荐它。

observations.description: 存在破坏游戏的bug，导致时间投入浪费
observations.evidence: game breaking bugs with wasted time invested
observations.evidence_zh: 破坏游戏的bug，还浪费了投入的时间

items.text:
Aight so, very in dev so understandable.
I would not recommend this game in it's current state, ESPECIALLY without multiple saves due to the gamebreaking bugs that can happen sometimes. Can't rollback to a save since its all one save, causing you to have to restart all over--I was almost finished my first ship and then the station glitched, causing my starter ship to get stuck in some walls and preventing me access to the all important station. I tried to re-dock to no avail and it's permanently stuck on my screen, even if i'm docked to a different place altogether. So yeah, don't play yet unless you are ready to lose everything in a second.
items.text_zh:
好吧，所以，还处于开发中，这可以理解。
我不推荐这款游戏当前的状态，尤其是没有多个存档的情况下，因为有时会出现破坏游戏的bug。没法回滚到某个存档，因为只有一个存档，导致你不得不从头重来——我第一艘船都快完成了，然后空间站出了故障，导致我的初始飞船卡在一些墙里，让我无法进入那个至关重要的空间站。我试着重新对接，但无济于事，它就永久卡在我的屏幕上，即使我完全对接到了另一个地方。所以是的，除非你准备好在一瞬间失去一切，否则先别玩。

observations.description: 游戏存在破坏性bug，且只有一个存档无法回滚，只能重开
observations.evidence: ESPECIALLY without multiple saves due to the gamebreaking bugs that can happen sometimes. Can't rollback to a save since its all one save, causing you to have to restart all over
observations.evidence_zh: 尤其是考虑到有时会出现破坏游戏的bug，却没有多个存档。由于只有一个存档，无法回滚到之前的存档，导致你不得不从头重新开始。
